about_the_game:
Overview

This is a game where you identify dangers and near-miss situations in various locations.

You have recently been appointed as the Chairperson of the Safety and Health Committee at your workplace.

As the new chairperson, it is your responsibility to learn about various near-miss incidents and potential hazards.

As part of your training, you will enter a virtual world created with digital twin technology, which closely replicates the real world.
In this simulation, avatars will engage in dangerous behaviors, and your mission is to identify and point out those hazards.

Contents

  • Collect manuals that describe the safety rules for each location.

  • When you find an avatar engaging in dangerous behavior or breaking the rules, confront them by presenting the manual.

  • Once the avatar is in a safe state, confirm it with a cheerful "Safety Check! (Yoshi!)"

  • Your work isn’t done until you return safely.
    There is also a time limit, so try to complete your tasks efficiently and reach the goal.

※ The images shown are from a development version and may be subject to change.
